title: Armenia: AI in healthcare rules
summary: No health AI strategy or doctor AI-training requirement found. National AI push (AI factory / data-center plan, 2025; AI in education). Experts say a formal strategy is missing (verify 2026). E-health system ArMed; e-prescribing from 2025; universal health insurance from 1 Jan 2026. Health Minister presented the first AI lab-data tool and said medical-data law needs changes.
fact: A policy gap, so voluntary, WHO-aligned training is the likely route.
caution: Binding? Nothing AI-specific. Never imply foreign rules bind Armenian or Gulf hospitals.
